title: Great Power Relations amid Global Transformation
summary: On 27 September 2026, the Russian-Chinese conference of the Valdai Discussion Club and the Centre for Russian Studies at East China Normal University, entitled “Great Power Relations amid Global Transformation,” took place—one of the Club’s flagship events, held twice a year, alternately in Russia and China.
